source: Semantic Model Preparation Checklist for Fabric Data Agent
note: The 18 items from the checklist that concern the agent rather than the model. These were excluded from the Analyzer's score because they are not observable in a .SemanticModel folder. Items with a `check` are now verified automatically when the agent's configuration is known.

items.text: Select the same tables in Data Agent that are defined in Prep for AI > AI Data Schema
items.why: Tables the agent can query but the schema does not describe produce unreliable answers. Tables the schema describes but the agent cannot reach are simply unused.

items.text: Test and validate responses before adding AI instructions
items.why: Instructions written before you have seen the failures tend to fix problems the agent did not have.

items.text: Add Data Agent instructions only for guidance that applies across ALL data sources
Add routing instructions when there are multiple semantic models, or a semantic model plus another source type
items.example: For revenue questions use the semantic model; for real-time delivery performance use the XYZ table from the KQL database.

items.text: Limit Data Agent instructions to response formatting, cross-source routing, common abbreviations, and tone
Do NOT add semantic-model-specific instructions at Data Agent level
items.why: Agent-level guidance applies to every source the agent can reach, so one model's internals leak into all of them.

items.text: Test responses before adding AI instructions to identify gaps
Review the DAX query in each response to verify accuracy and pattern
items.why: The agent shows the query it generated. A right answer from wrong DAX will not stay right.

items.text: When results are wrong, identify which layer needs adjustment: AI data schema, verified answers, or AI instructions
If responses are slow, analyse DAX performance and keep AI instructions concise
Test with fields inside the AI data schema, which should return answers
Verify that trigger questions return the correct verified answers
Use the Fabric Data Agent Python SDK for automated evaluation against ground truth
Download and review the diagnostics logs when debugging
Iterate on the configuration based on validation findings
Use Git and deployment pipelines for Data Agent lifecycle management
Add a Data Agent description before publishing
Add publishing instructions if the Data Agent is used in Microsoft 365 Copilot
